title: Sum of elements of a vector

blocks.content: Sum of elements of a vector
Write a program to calculate the sum of elements of a vector.

items: Declare an integer vector called marks and initialize it with the values 100, 98, 64, 100, 23, 88.
Calculate the sum of marks using the accumulate() function.
Store the result in a variable sum.
